verdict.rationale: Rippling's time-and-attendance product claims it 'automatically applies the correct labor policies...based on location, and flags potential risks based on each employee's work location so managers can act before issues reach payroll' (docs-26/45), which is a proactive compliance-risk alert tied to location, and it auto-files payroll taxes (docs-40/44). However there is no evidence of alerts specifically triggered by a new hire event or by a change in law/regulation, nor any dedicated compliance-notification dashboard for founders. Missing for 10: alerts tied to new-hire onboarding events, alerts triggered by legal/regulatory changes, and any first-party documentation of a compliance alerting/notification center.
